exact_regular_class: A massive-material or observer worldline is a locally finite piecewise-C1 map γ:I→M from a nondegenerate real interval I, with a nonzero future timelike derivative on each smooth piece (one-sided at included endpoints); C2 regularity on a piece is required when acceleration is used.
parameter_scope: The parameter λ has no physical meaning by itself and may be replaced by a C1 increasing parameter.
trade_off: Make the standard C1 extension to each included one-sided endpoint explicit, preserving finite corners and all proper-time/four-velocity claims. A secant tangent without continuous velocity limits is strictly weaker, is not equivalent, and cannot imply the claimed continuous norm extension. The approved prose does not explicitly promise that weaker nonstandard class.
